picQs.s: She is afraid to talk to new people. She is ___.
He sleeps and doesn't like to work. He is ___.
He always says please and thank you. He is ___.
Her room is clean and all her things are in order. She is ___.

summary.title: Personality adjectives
goals: I can say twelve personality adjectives.
I can match adjectives to their opposites and notice the prefix un-.
I can say what personality a job needs.

defs.shy: afraid to talk to new people
defs.confident: not afraid in front of others
defs.hard-working: works a lot and finishes the work
defs.mean: is not nice and doesn't share
defs.rude: doesn't say please or thank you

prefix.note: Add un- to make some opposites.
prefix.other: Some opposites are different words: kind – mean, polite – rude.

structure.rule: In my job, I need to be + adjective.
examples: I'm a doctor. In my job, I need to be kind and hard-working.
I'm a waiter. In my job, I need to be polite and friendly.

summary.tip: Think of the opposite when you learn a new word.

exam.title: Look and circle the correct word.
Match each adjective to its opposite.

items.s: The opposite of polite is rude.
A tidy person has got all their things in a mess.
We add un- to friendly to make its opposite.

items.q: In my job, I need ___ kind.
Ahmed leaves his books and clothes everywhere. He is ___.
Which adjective is NOT made with un-?
A person who talks easily on a stage is ___.

exam.title: Add un- and write the opposite.
Complete the sentence with two adjectives.
exam.s: I'm a teacher. In my job, I need to be ________ and ________.
exam.a: Any two positive adjectives, e.g. kind and hard-working (½ mark each).
